_provenance.notes: Alaska Pacific cod (Gadus macrocephalus) is the second most important Alaska groundfish by value. The 2015-2019 marine heatwave caused a catastrophic decline in Gulf of Alaska Pacific cod — estimated 75-80% population reduction (Barbeaux et al. 2020). This resulted in the first-ever COD FISHERY DISASTER DECLARATION in 2019. BSAI Pacific cod populations were less severely affected due to cold pool buffering.
